Current RTL:
module reg_if_09 (
  input clk,
  input rst_n,
  input [7:0] in_data,
  output [7:0] out_data
);

  reg [7:0] reg_bank [0:0];
  wire parity_in;
  wire parity_out;
  wire data_valid;

  // Parity calculation for input data
  assign parity_in = ^in_data;

  // Register write operation
  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
      reg_bank[0] <= 8'd0;
    end else begin
      reg_bank[0] <= in_data;
    end
  end

  // Parity calculation for stored data
  assign parity_out = ^reg_bank[0];

  // Data integrity check on read
  assign data_valid = (parity_in == parity_out);

  // Output data with integrity check
  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
      out_data <= 8'd0;
    end else if (data_valid) begin
      out_data <= reg_bank[0];
    end else begin
      out_data <= 8'd0; // Return zero on parity error
    end
  end

endmodule

module reg_if_09 (
  input clk,
  input rst_n,
  input [7:0] in_data,
  output [7:0] out_data
);

  reg [7:0] reg_bank [0:0];
  wire parity_in;
  wire parity_out;
  wire data_valid;

  // Parity calculation for input data
  assign parity_in = ^in_data;

  // Register write operation
  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
      reg_bank[0] <= 8'd0;
    end else begin
      reg_bank[0] <= in_data;
    end
  end

  // Parity calculation for stored data
  assign parity_out = ^reg_bank[0];

  // Data integrity check on read
  assign data_valid = (parity_in == parity_out);

  // Output data with integrity check
  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
      out_data <= 8'd0;
    end else if (data_valid) begin
      out_data <= reg_bank[0];
    end else begin
      out_data <= 8'd0; // Return zero on parity error
    end
  end

endmodule
